Important interview answer: JavaScript is always pass by value. For objects, the copied value is a
reference to the object, so modifying its properties can affect the original object.
English: Error handling is the process of detecting and managing errors during program execution.
සිංහල: Program එJකේ ඇතිවන errors නිවැරදිව handle කිරීම.
Keyword Purpose · try Execute risky code · catch Handle exceptions · finally Execute cleanup code · throw Create an exception
Interview question: Why is error handling important?
Answer: Error handling prevents unexpected failures from disrupting the application and improves
Stack සහ Heap කියෙන්Jන් memory management සමේබන්ධ concepts Jදෙකකේ.
Function calls සහ execution frames වැනි Jදේ manage කරන memory structure එකකේ.
